text: {"frames":["The wind dropped all at once, and the sails of the mill on the Tower stopped in mid-turn. The grain still sat in the stone hopper, and the miller, Sjoerd Kruimelmolen, could not find the sack of wheat anywhere. Then a thump came from the schoolroom below, where the children were hunting for the lost sack under their desks. The schoolmistress, Antje Pompebla, wants new matting laid before the wind returns to turn the sails. About how many square metres does the classroom floor cover?","Please, come quickly, the tulips have opened in the wrong colour! cried Wiebe Bollenkamp, waving a petal at you from the bulb store. The crates of bulbs must be carried into the classroom on the ground floor, where the children will sort them by colour. Stacking the crates is slow work, and the schoolmistress wants to know how much floor there is before the carts arrive. The room is long and narrow, with a window at each end and the canal wall on one side. About how many square metres is the classroom floor?","The smell reaches you before the sound does: sharp, sweet, and thick with linseed. A tin of green paint has spilled across the stairs and into the schoolroom below, where the painter Joost Mallemolen kneels on the boards with a rag. The schoolmistress wants the floor repainted before the children come back on Monday. She has only a small pot left, and she needs to know how much paint the whole floor will take. About how many square metres does the classroom floor cover?","You pull the ladder across the library shelves and climb to the top row. Every book has moved: the storybooks sit with the sums, and the map books lie in the cookery pile. The librarian, Hendrika Zoutvlieg, has sent the children down to the schoolroom with the whole stack. She wants to lay out the shelves again so each book has its place, and she needs to know how much room there is. About how many square metres does the classroom floor cover?","Water is coming through the wall, and it is getting higher! shouted Sientje-of-the-Dyke from the ground floor. A crack has opened in the schoolroom wall, and the canal is pushing brown water across the boards. The men will stack sandbags in rows along the wall, and the watchman wants to know how much floor the water has to cover before the sandbags go in. About how many square metres is the classroom?"]}
